parts.name: Screen Side
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen side of a laptop, typically made of aluminum alloy for durability and lightweight design.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the display panel and webcam, providing the visual interface for the user.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge to open or close the laptop.

parts.name: Base Side
parts.Basic_description: This is the base side of the laptop, made of aluminum alloy and containing the keyboard, touchpad, and internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the keyboard, touchpad, and internal hardware such as the motherboard and battery.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the screen side moves relative to it.

parts.name: Connector
parts.Basic_description: This is the hinge connector of the laptop, made of stainless steel for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the screen and base sides, allowing smooth rotation and maintaining structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates to enable the opening and closing motion of the laptop.

parts.name: Fragmentation (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This is a small miscellaneous part of the laptop, likely a minor plastic component such as a port cover or trim piece.
parts.Functional_description: It provides aesthetic finishing or minor protection for internal components.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal laptop operation.
